question: Related Questions Q. Bath soaps having glycerin 4913 views Q. What to do in this situation and is there any alternative way to solve this.Fear of committing zina. 4965 views Q. "In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful" Asalamo Alykum, I once had plans to go abroad for studies. I did an Isthekhara for it. I saw my father crying over some mutual business partners' loss and somebody telling me that my father is already burnt. It was such a painful dream that I woke up with tears in my eyes. I gathered from it that my father has spent much on us and much of it is from Sood. So do not pressurize him for more expenditures so that he is forced to stick to Sood. I quit my plans for study abroad, and I have been trying for him to leave all Soodi investments. But when i think that the dream said "he is already burnt" i feel perhaps it is no use. The sin has amounted so much that Allah na karae, but he will burn in hell for sure. So I get disheartened. I also get disheartened because he has started taking out money from Soodi investments upon our insistence but he does not really consider it a sin. He says it is not that kind of forbidden Sood. So I wonder, even if he takes out all his soodi investment, if the remorse is not there, perhaps he will not be forgiven for lack of Tauba. How do you interpret the dream? 2520 views Q. Now my aunt is doing this twice a week and her daughter is healthy and recovered. She (my aunt) wants to know is it Jaaiz? As we know Shariaah provides some relaxation under special circumstances. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 150234 Country: Bangladesh Title: Adobe photoshop software Question: (1) An Adobe Photoshop software new version price may be 100000 BDT. If anyone use the software by download from internet. Is it halal? (2) And earn money making graphics from that Photoshop is halal? Answer ID: 150234 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 945/1027/M=9/1438) (1-2) If it is generally allowed to download the said software from the internet then you may download it and use it. It is not unlawful to earn the money lawfully, rather it is mandatory to avoid its unlawful use (making unlawful pictures). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
